did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. The owner of a restaurant (Crispy House) opened its settings, changed the opening hours from 10:00 to 23:30 into 06:00 to 09:00 (the time on the clock was about 10:50) and saved. The dashboard was read, and a customer opened the restaurant page.

checks.text: Before the change the restaurant says "Open now · 10:00 – 23:30"
After it, with no other action and with "I am open" still ticked, it says "Closed now · 06:00 – 09:00": the hours close it by themselves
The customer sees "Closed now" on the banner and "This restaurant is closed now. You can look at the menu, but you cannot order."; every Add button is disabled

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. The hours were put back afterwards.
Closing at the set time was shown by choosing hours that already do not include the time now; the page was not left open until a real closing time.

shots.caption: After changing the hours: Closed now
The customer: closed, menu readable, cannot order
